create_CodeGenerator: create a CodeGenerator vocoder instance with embedding dimensions, speaker and language IDs, and duration predictor params
run_CodeGenerator_forward: run the CodeGenerator forward pass with a sample dict containing codes, speaker IDs, and language IDs
test_CodeGenerator_upsample: test the CodeGenerator _upsample static method to upsample speaker and language embedding signals
build_CodeGenerator_dur_prediction: build a CodeGenerator with a duration predictor to expand code embeddings by predicted durations
review_CodeGenerator_forward: review the CodeGenerator forward method that combines code, speaker, and language embeddings before passing to the base generator
